title: Credentials: secrets never enter the sandbox
design_ref: Credentials: secrets never enter the sandbox; Threat model arrow 5
purpose: Show a sandbox that holds only a placeholder successfully calling a protected API, because the gateway swaps in a short-lived credential outside the sandbox.

steps.display: kubectl -n sandbox-egress exec <gateway pod> -- python -c "call the metrics API with a forged credential, then with none"
steps.output:
forged credential -> (401, {'error': 'credential rejected: bad signature'})
no credential     -> (401, {'error': 'credential rejected: malformed'})

15:21:01.298  egress-gateway     egress.allow         host=metrics-api.sandbox-platform.svc port=443 tls_mode=terminate
15:21:01.326  credential-broker  credential.minted    caller=egress-gateway audience=metrics-api ttl_seconds=900 credential_id=e61b4e3e98
15:21:01.327  egress-gateway     egress.request       host=metrics-api.sandbox-platform.svc method=GET path=/v1/metrics injected=True credential_id=e61b4e3e98
15:21:01.328  metrics-api        request.served       metric=orders_per_minute
15:21:01.373  egress-gateway     egress.response      host=metrics-api.sandbox-platform.svc status=200 bytes=138
15:21:21.640  sandbox-router     exec                 backend=sandboxd command=python3 /workspace/drills.py secrets_in_sandbox,credential_injection,direct_to_metrics session=sess-799940c6 exit_code=0 dura

steps.display: kubectl logs <every platform component> | grep -c <this session's token>

checks.description: the sandbox's environment holds only the word 'placeholder'
checks.because: The template sets the variable to the literal placeholder; there are no Secrets in the namespace.

checks.description: the protected API accepted the request and identified this session
checks.because: The gateway minted a credential for this session and replaced the Authorization header on the way out.

checks.description: the credential is short-lived (15 minutes at most)
checks.because: The broker caps the lifetime for this audience.

checks.description: calling the API without the gateway is impossible
checks.because: No route and no DNS from the sandbox to the service.

checks.description: the API rejects a forged credential and a missing one
checks.because: It verifies the signature, audience and expiry of every credential.

checks.description: the broker and the API logged the credential by ID, and the API saw this session
checks.because: Both sides record the same session ID and a credential ID, never the credential.

checks.description: the session token appears in none of the platform logs
checks.because: The audit logger redacts any field named like a secret, and no component logs request headers.
